Professional Summary

DevOps engineer with 5+ years of professional experience, 3+ of them in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering across AWS, Azure and GCP. Owns migrations of example workloads from on-premises data centres to managed Kubernetes, from discovery and target design through cutover and validation. Comfortable where infrastructure meets application behaviour, following a failure from scheduling and storage through to service networking instead of handing it over. Daily stack is Kubernetes, Docker and Helm, Terraform and Ansible, with on-call and observability work under agreed service levels.

Professional Experience

EXAMPLE CORPSpringfield, Exampleland
Senior Associate (DevOps Engineer), PlatformMar 2024 - Present
  • Sole owner of example platform migrations from on-premises servers to containerised cloud environments, running discovery, target design, build, cutover and validation across development, testing and production.
  • Ran a mixed Windows and Linux analytics workload on one shared Kubernetes cluster, using node affinity, OS-specific scheduling and cross-platform service networking instead of two separate clusters.
  • Debugged the cluster through bring-up, working through pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff and persistent volumes that failed to mount, until the whole workload ran end to end.
  • Replaced manual recovery of failed releases on self-managed clusters with a pipeline that detects failure, retries and rolls back on its own, so environments recover without an engineer.
  • Closed the manual handoff between the infrastructure and web teams on a client website programme by automating build, content release and environment configuration through to production.
SAMPLE SYSTEMSSpringfield, Exampleland
Junior Platform ConsultantJan 2021 - Feb 2024
  • Ran two example industrial platforms across on-premises data centres and public cloud (AWS, GCP), owning availability, scaling and release automation for both customer
